# REFERENCE STACK — MV-22 (autogenerated per project, built 2026-11-20 before volley 1)

All refs generated in-project (media.generate_image), cropped to 16:9 (1920x1080), warm photoreal, zero text. Character refs READ BACK and verified by eye before use: Marco — salt-and-pepper swept-back hair, big dark moustache, white chef jacket, red neckerchief, flour-dusted dark apron (matches lock); Rosa — dark hair in a neat bun, burgundy blouse, black apron, serving spoon (matches lock). Kitchen ref note: the giant pot reads lid-off with spaghetti mounded and steaming — the lid-lift events (S01/S25) prompt the lid explicitly; the ref pins the pot, stove and world.

Per-scene start/end pairs are derived from the refs above + chain frames as the build proceeds; each vehicle names its refs.
